description: Put a declarative claim (thesis), contract clause, scientific hypothesis, or AI output on formal adversarial trial against explicit ground-truth axioms, a Small World (@domain:tag), and/or live Custom Epistemic Connectors (SQL tables, REST webhooks, retrieval sub-agents) using Synproof's 5-sieve Syntropy dialectical engine. Returns a deterministic CONFIRMED or REFUTED verdict.

custom_connectors.description: Optional list of inline Custom Epistemic Connectors ({'name': 'ERP API', 'connector_type': 'rest_webhook'|'sql_table_snapshot'|'agent_endpoint'|'mcp_tool', 'endpoint_url': 'https://...', 'static_rows': [...]}).

enable_research.description: Whether to enable external academic/statutory research tools during debate.

initial_axioms.description: Optional list of sanitized ground-truth axioms that strictly override model priors.

max_failures.description: Sceptical exhaustion limit (number of failed attack attempts required to confirm, 1-10).

thesis.description: The specific, declarative claim to put on trial (treated strictly as inert data).

world.description: Optional Small World handle(s) such as '@law:civil-code-obligations', '@law:eu-gdpr-data-protection', '@finance:basel-iii-aml-compliance', or a private fork.

name: syntropy_verify
